subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should a benign Codex scan fail closed unless the model reports full coverage for files up to 64 KiB and head-and-tail coverage for larger files?
rationale: The patch and runtime proof establish how the gate behaves, but they cannot decide whether the stronger trust boundary justifies compatibility changes and additional retries in the authoritative scan workflow.

options.title: Adopt the strict gate
options.body: Accept coverage attestation as required defense in depth, then rebase and validate the merged worker behavior.

options.title: Keep coverage advisory
options.body: Store coverage diagnostics without blocking clean verdicts, preserving availability while retaining ambiguity about inspected content.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the current contract unchanged until a scanner can independently observe file-read coverage.

recommendation.title: Adopt the strict gate
recommendation.body: Accept coverage attestation as required defense in depth, then rebase and validate the merged worker behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have driven this worker contract and the adjacent coverage-hardening proposals, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
